title: Open loci of the types of constant local module models
statement: Let X be a scheme and Λ a commutative ring. Let W_i → X be a scheme pro-etale covering [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. Suppose the inverse image of a sheaf F of Λ-modules on W_i is isomorphic to the constant sheaf of M_i [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image, def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf]. There exist opens O_i of X such that for every j and y ∈ W_j, the image of y lies in O_i if and only if M_j and M_i are isomorphic as Λ-modules. These opens cover X. No finiteness assumption on Λ or the M_i is required.

source.place: Tag 099Y, proof of lemma-compare-locally-constant; Open loci of the types of constant local module models

proof.text: A point of a double overlap lifts to an algebraically closed residue field. The two local constant models have the same geometric fiber, hence are isomorphic. Use the existing geometric-fiber restriction and constant-sheaf identifications.

For each i set the open on W_j equal to the whole space if M_j is isomorphic to M_i and the empty open otherwise. The overlap result makes these opens compatible. A pro-etale covering is fpqc, so descend them to an open O_i by fpqc open descent. Its inverse images give the stated equivalence.
For each x ∈ X, choose y on some W_j above x. The identity of M_j shows x ∈ O_j, so the O_i cover.

lean.statement:
theorem proEtale_model_type_opens
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ]
    (F : Sheaf (ProEt.topology X) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ))
    {I : Type (u + 1)} (W : I → Scheme.{u}) (g : ∀ i, W i ⟶ X)
    (hg : Presieve.ofArrows W g ∈ Scheme.proetalePrecoverage X)
    (M : I → ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)
    (e : ∀ i, (AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) (g i)).obj F ≅
      (constantSheaf (ProEt.topology (W i)) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)).obj (M i)) :
    ∃ O : I → X.Opens,
      (∀ i j (y : W j), g j y ∈ O i ↔ Nonempty (M j ≅ M i)) ∧
      (⋃ i, (O i : Set X)) = Set.univ
